title: Quote
description: A purchasing quote (orçamento), matching purchasing-service's domain.Quote wire shape. QuoteLine is intentionally local to this schema — it is NOT $ref'd to sales-service's OrderItem, which stays a separate, independently-evolving shape per its own bounded context.

id.description: Server-assigned; absent on a create request.

subtotal_amount.description: Server-computed: sum of item totals. Absent/ignored on a create or update request.

total_amount.description: Server-computed: subtotal - discount + delivery. Absent/ignored on a create or update request.

created_at.description: Server-assigned; absent on a create request.

QuoteStatus.title: QuoteStatus
QuoteStatus.description: Server-assigned; absent/ignored on a create or update request.

id.description: Server-assigned; absent on a create/update request.
